potion_satyr.name: Potion of Satyr
potion_satyr.description: Grants the Satyr trait permanently (libido min 10, +3 Sex, +2 Group). Craft-only. Male only.

potion_cum_addict.name: Potion of Cum Addiction
potion_cum_addict.description: Grants the Cum Addict trait permanently (+3 Oral, +3 libido regen/day). Craft-only.

handwritten_poem.name: Handwritten Poem
handwritten_poem.description: A poem written by hand on fine paper. A deeply personal gesture. Yvara: +4 Devotion, +4 Affection. Worker gift effect: +2 Relationship, +2 Joy, +2 Romance.

botanical_pressing.name: Botanical Pressing
botanical_pressing.description: A collection of pressed and labelled plant specimens. Thoughtful and scholarly. Yvara: +3 Devotion, +3 Affection. Worker gift effect: +2 Relationship, +2 Joy, +1 Romance.

spiked_tea.name: Spiked Tea Blend
spiked_tea.description: A fine herbal tea with an unusual addition. The recipient may not notice. Yvara: +3 Dominion, +1 Affection. Worker gift effect: -1 Relationship, -1 Joy, -2 Rebelliousness.

silk_ribbon.name: Silk Ribbon
silk_ribbon.description: A length of fine silk ribbon. The implication depends entirely on the giver. Yvara: +2 Dominion, +2 Affection. Worker gift effect: +1 Relationship, +1 Joy, +2 Romance, -1 Rebelliousness.

cipher_lattice.name: Cryptographer's Lattice
cipher_lattice.description: A ruled transparency for aligning academy seal-glyphs. Sold mostly as a curiosity in the Elite Emporium at a price that could buy a year of patience. It will not read a codex for you—but it can force a stubborn ring-cipher open when you refuse to wrestle glyphs by hand.

basic_strategist_notebook.name: Strategist Notebook
basic_strategist_notebook.description: A practical notebook full of plans, routines, and margin notes for better decision-making. (+3 Clever)

advanced_tactician_monocle.name: Tactician Monocle
advanced_tactician_monocle.description: A precision-cut monocle that helps read people, risks, and opportunities at a glance. (+6 Clever)

elite_mastermind_diary.name: Mastermind Diary
elite_mastermind_diary.description: A coded diary used by master planners to map leverage, timing, and perfect execution. (+9 Clever)

test_manager_level.name: Test Manager Level
test_manager_level.description: Test item: consumed on purchase. Raises Manager level by 1 and grants 1 skill point to assign.
